name: pair_target_construction_integrity
purpose: Verify pair labels are constructible, non-ambiguous, and not dominated by ties.
pass_criteria: All pairs have valid labels; tie/ambiguous exclusion is documented; per-task counts are nonzero.

name: LOSO_pair_leakage_guard
purpose: Verify train/test pairs are subject-disjoint and no trial pair or reversed pair leaks across folds.

name: pair_retention_balance_audit
purpose: Check whether enough pairs remain after margin/tie rules and whether labels are balanced.
pass_criteria: retention, label balance, and fold coverage meet thresholds declared in the smoke objective

name: position_and_majority_baseline_control
purpose: Ensure the target is not solved by pair order, majority class, or fold artifacts.
pass_criteria: randomized pair order and no-feature controls remain near expected chance behavior

name: metric_sanity_control
purpose: Verify pairwise metrics respond correctly to perfect, random, and shuffled predictions.
pass_criteria: perfect synthetic cases score high; shuffled controls remain near chance

name: reproducibility_guard
purpose: Ensure future executable smoke-test code is committed under scripts/idare or archived before use.
pass_criteria: script path and manifest are committed before any smoke-test run
